name: Fare Search Cache
summary: A caching layer in front of supplier fare APIs, with time-based invalidation per route.
outcomes: p95 search latency dropped from 1.8 s to 450 ms.
Calls to supplier APIs dropped by 40%.

name: Idempotent Booking Service
summary: A rewrite of the booking API with idempotency keys and safe retries towards suppliers.
outcomes: Duplicate bookings caused by client retries dropped to zero.

name: Lab Results Pipeline
summary: An event-driven pipeline that ingests lab results from partner labs, validates them and makes them available to clinicians.
outcomes: Time from lab result to clinician view dropped from 15 minutes (nightly batches) to under 30 seconds.

name: Patient Data Access Audit Log
summary: An append-only audit log of every access to patient records, with a query API for the compliance team.
outcomes: The yearly compliance audit found no issues in access logging.
Audit queries that took hours of manual work now take minutes.

name: Internal Delivery Platform
summary: Shared Terraform modules and reusable GitHub Actions workflows that product teams use to create and ship new services.
outcomes: Setting up a new service went from about 3 days to about 2 hours.
25 services were onboarded onto the platform.

name: AWS Cost Optimization
summary: A review of Lambda memory settings, DynamoDB capacity modes and log retention across all services.
outcomes: The monthly AWS bill dropped by 28%.
